title: Learned F4 column / pivot policy
original_requirement: Train F4 column and pivot policies with trace transfer per shape, on Boolean systems at memory frontier.
acceptance_criteria: Only correctness-preserving choices exposed; deterministic inexpensive heuristics are controls.
Heldout targets and shapes, explicit transfer tests; full cost/inference/fallback and peak memory.
Independent row-space/result certificates and total cost rather than in-sample reward.
remaining_gaps: RELN715aa1 approves Stage0 derivation only and is not authority to run learned solver trials.
Need policy hook, trace exporter, action legality/certificates and heldout training/evaluation implementation; no such complete adapter bound.
execution_note: Commands are source bindings, not launch receipts; preserve original trials and output to a fresh location through the applicable runner. No official approval or status transition is implied.
original_audit_text: Learned F4 column and pivot policy, with per-shape trace transfer. The gbrl work did PPO on toy Buchberger over F_p and never touched F4, Boolean systems, or the memory wall. The roadmap item never became a hypothesis.
